desc:
Build. Drive. Destroy. Dominate.

🔧 BUILD — Craft cars, tanks, jets, mechs, and more. Your workshop, your rules.

⚙️ CONTROL — Build transforming machines, switch battle modes, aim, lock on, and fire.

🏎️ DRIVE — Real physics on land and in the air. Every terrain, every weight, every speed. Race the rally track and chase world records.

💥 DESTROY — Machine guns, lasers, missiles, saws, drills, and claws. Crush monsters, world bosses, and rival players.

🏆 COMPETE — Battle other players in the arena. Smash rivals and climb the leaderboards.

📐 SHARE — The Blueprint Shop is full of player designs. Share your unique builds, get likes, downloads, and earn Gold.

Build legendary vehicles. Start your engines and dominate the arena!
